# laravelforge_site_commands (Resource)

Run a command on the site.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "laravelforge_site_commands" "example" {
  command      = "example-command"
  organization = "my-org"
  server       = 123456
  site         = 123456
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `command` (String) The command that ran.
- `organization` (String) The organization slug
- `server` (Number) The server ID
- `site` (Number) The site ID

### Optional

- `opcache_enabled` (Boolean)

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The date and time the command was created.
- `duration` (String) The duration of the command in human-readable format.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `status` (String)
- `updated_at` (String) The date and time the command was last updated.
- `user` (String)
- `user_id` (Number) The ID of the user who initiated the command.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import laravelforge_site_commands.example my-org/123456/123456/123
```
